scope: Narrow UIKit rich-block provider isolation/lifecycle follow-up; no parser, selection mapping, or app behavior edits.

diagnosis.public_declarations: NSTextAttachmentViewProvider has no MainActor declaration; UIView is MainActor. Package manifest tools-version5.9 has no language/default-isolation override. Explicit foreign MainActor owner access and own isolated method calls therefore require an actor boundary.
diagnosis.original_probe: The disposable Swift5/minimal-concurrency language probe reproduced three fatal compiler diagnostics. This is language evidence, not an Apple archive failure.
diagnosis.original_sync_attempt: A15-second foreground probe attempt timed out before returning diagnostics. It was retried once as background job_e36c7ea08dad; the background result above is authoritative.
diagnosis.callback_contract: Apple's public provider declarations do not promise a callback thread. loadView is framework-owned and must not be called directly.

change: UI-owned properties and helpers are MainActor-isolated; parser attachments remain immutable and their owner stays weak.
Framework callbacks remain nonisolated. Synchronous UI work uses MainActor.assumeIsolated only after Thread.isMainThread succeeds.
Off-main callbacks use a lock-protected finite size cache and enqueue a MainActor handoff. No UI or closures execute under the lock; no blocking main-queue dispatch occurs.
One pending handoff coalesces repeated measurement/setup requests; stable measured width and height stop further measurement requests.
A private idempotent ensureHost helper replaces the previous direct loadView call.
Changed layout invalidation is deferred and coalesced, and checks that the owner is still mounted with an attachment environment.

validation.cache_domain: 25 assertions passed, including latest-width coalescing, stable-size convergence, finite unknown geometry, invalid proposals, and 1024 concurrent requests producing one pending handoff.
